name: Kemonomichi -Nana-
source:
The magic soldier of thunder is captured by monsters and becomes a test subject for a drug under development.
Crossbreeding with monsters was thought to be impossible , but...!?

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE129934.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
雷之魔法战士被怪物抓住，成为正在研发的药物实验对象。
与怪物杂交本来被认为是不可能的事，可是……！？

（来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE129934.html]DLsite English[/url]）
